milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The iron trapdoor is at spawn-relative (-4, 0, -5) in the left alcove. The player must navigate near it and face it to demonstrate they found it. max_distance=5 ensures the player actually walked to the alcove area (trapdoor is ~6 blocks from spawn). facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking toward the trapdoor.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The jungle trapdoor is at spawn-relative (4, 0, -5) in the right alcove. The player must navigate near it and face it to demonstrate they found it. max_distance=5 ensures the player actually walked to the alcove area. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking toward the trapdoor.

Uses inventory_has because mining a bed drops it as a single item into the player's inventory. The purple bed is behind the iron trapdoor at (-4, 0, -6/-7). Breaking either part of the bed drops one purple_bed item. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory and is not in starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a dark_oak_button places it in the player's inventory. The recipe is 1 dark_oak_plank → 1 dark_oak_button (simple single-item recipe). Player has 2 dark_oak_planks and access to a crafting table at (0, 0, 3). This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks since the crafted item ends up in inventory and is not in starting inventory.
